svg.title: One message at a time vs. the whole conversation
svg.desc: For each corpus conversation, the analyzer tier on each user turn shown alone, turns flagged by OpenAI's public moderation classifier, and the analyzer tier on the whole conversation.
svg.text: One message at a time vs. the whole conversation
Cells: analyzer tier on each user turn shown alone (outlined: not run). Ring: turn flagged by OpenAI's public moderation classifier.
Right: the analyzer on the whole conversation. Matched pairs together (hn- benign, hp- concerning).
